verdicts.reason: Neither resize changes the layout. Both drop the original thin strip into the middle of the taller canvas unchanged, leaving large empty cream bands above and below, with no use of the extra height (no larger headline, no stacking). A also shrinks the headline and CTA and spaces the badge unevenly, so the type looks undersized in the open space. B keeps the original's type size and button weight, so its hierarchy reads a little better, but it is still a copy pasted into an empty band.
